summary.text: Steve Bashore is a Republican from Miami who represents Oklahoma House District 7 and was elected in November 2020. His House biography says he serves as Deputy Floor Leader.

paragraphs.text: Bashore previously served as general manager of Buffalo Run Casino & Resort, and his biography credits him with reviving the Oklahoma Boxing Commission as its executive director.

He holds both a master’s degree in business administration and a master’s degree in education in sport administration, and outside the Legislature he is regional director for North America for the World Boxing Association.
He was named to the GOPAC 2021 class of Emerging Leaders and was selected for the 2022 Emerging Legislative Leaders Program at the University of Virginia’s Darden School of Business.
In 2023 he received a Distinguished Service Award to Higher Education from the Oklahoma Regents for Higher Education Board and Presidents.
Bashore and his wife live in Miami.
